name: secure-system-development
description: Security and engineering red lines for designing, writing, and reviewing websites, backend services, and APIs: hardened auth, injection prevention, business-logic and race-condition defense, high-concurrency database design, async-first architecture, API integrity and anti-tampering, secrets and operations, AI/LLM security, mobile and mini-program security, CORS and security headers, scenario-aware 404 and indexing rules.

interface.shortDescription: Design and review websites, backends, and APIs without shipping the usual security holes
interface.longDescription: Applies security and engineering red lines across the full build cycle: threat modeling, hardened authentication and authorization, injection prevention, business-logic and race-condition defense, high-concurrency database design, async-first architecture with idempotent consumers, API integrity and anti-tampering, secrets and operations security, AI/LLM application security, mobile and mini-program security, CORS and security headers, and scenario-aware 404 and indexing rules. Includes an executable red-line scanner and review templates.
defaultPrompt: Review this login endpoint and database schema against the security red lines.
Scan this project for security red-line violations and fix the high-severity findings.
